words.zhExample: 明亮的月亮照亮了宁静的湖面。

words.enExample: He expressed his gratitude with a letter.
words.zhExample: 他用一封信表达了感激之情。

essay.title: A Letter to Tomorrow
essay.author: Anonymous
paragraphs: Dear Tomorrow, I am writing to tell you that I tried my best today.
I may have stumbled, but each stumble taught me where the ground was uneven. I am learning to walk more surely.
Please be gentle, and I promise to meet you with the same courage I found tonight.
